scope: 4 cases,5 sampled frames each; no score or full60 visual acceptance
compared: BI400 normal versus CI400 normal, matched I2V initial images/prompts/noise

cases.VP002: Both mostly retain two people and bowed strip with little process; no clear improvement.
cases.VP004: CI has substantial late face/body distortion and ruler/mouth fusion; BI has ruler/process failure but less late portrait distortion.
cases.VP009: CI changes to panel/picture close-up and loses worker late; BI retains more of worker although tool/glass action wrong.
cases.VP015: Both retain rower, kayak, lake; CI looks steadier in this sampled view but water/drips and actual oar process still need scrutiny.

implication: Native-video V in a separately added attention/FFN difference is insufficient for visual quality. DT uses one native attention with video-dependent physical Q/K modulation, not CI additive response. This is a design distinction, not isolated causal proof.
